lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid on the posterior-lateral flank. Spots are organized into at least six distinct horizontal rows, with inter-spot distance increasing slightly in the posterior direction within the visible field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot-rows to form a grid. High-luminance blobs are positioned at the approximate centroids of these intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp luminance transition from high-intensity highlights on the superior edge to lower-intensity shadow gradients on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Five vertical branchial slits (gills) are clearly delineated with sharp contrast against the lateral flank. Multiple small, dark, elongated shapes (remoras) are visible in the ventral water column.
